package members_test

import (
	"context"
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/credentials/insecure"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/test/bufconn"

	pb "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/grpc/members/pb"
	server "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/grpc/members/server"
	members "example.com/grpcmembers/gen/members"
)

func mountedClient(t *testing.T, endpoints *members.Endpoints) (context.Context, pb.MembersClient) {
	t.Helper()
	listener := bufconn.Listen(1024 * 1024)
	native := grpc.NewServer()
	pb.RegisterMembersServer(native, server.New(endpoints, nil))
	result := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() {
		result <- native.Serve(listener)

	}()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		native.Stop()
		require.NoError(t, <-result)

	})
	conn, err := grpc.NewClient("passthrough:///members", grpc.WithTransportCredentials(insecure.NewCredentials()), grpc.WithContextDialer(func(context.Context, string) (net.Conn, error) {
		return listener.Dial()

	}))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		require.NoError(t, conn.Close())

	})
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	t.Cleanup(cancel)
	return ctx, pb.NewMembersClient(conn)
}
